mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.shop_name, s.logo_file_id, s.description, s.contact, s.shipping_address, s.created_at, s.updated_at, f.bucket AS logo_bucket, f.object_key AS logo_object_key FROM shop_profile s LEFT JOIN file_object f ON f.id = s.logo_file_id WHERE s.id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_profile SET shop_name = #{shopName}, description = #{description}, contact = #{contact}, shipping_address = #{shippingAddress}, logo_file_id = #{logoFileId} WHERE id = 1
